[[Ancient Wood Plank]]s are a high-level [[refinement|refined]] [[crafting material]] used primarily for creating {{rarity|Exotic}}-level items. They are created from 3 [[Ancient Wood Log]]s and require a crafting level of '''400''' ({{artificer}},{{huntsman}},{{weaponsmith}},{{scribe}}) to make.
